question: The Bhoramdev Corridor Development Project in Chhattisgarh is being developed under which Central Government scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swadesh Darshan Scheme 2.0.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The foundation stone of the Bhoramdev Corridor Development Project was laid in Chhattisgarh under the Swadesh Darshan Scheme 2.0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Bhoramdev Corridor Development Project is funded under the Swadesh Darshan Scheme 2.0.**
 
• The project is being developed at an estimated cost of about ₹146 crore.
 
• It is modelled on the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor in Varanasi.
 
• The project aims to boost religious tourism and regional development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Swadesh Darshan Scheme 2.0__

 __
 
• A flagship tourism development scheme of the Ministry of Tourism.
 
• Focuses on sustainable and responsible destination development.
 
• Aims to enhance infrastructure at iconic and spiritual destinations.
 
 
 
• Bhoramdev Corridor Project__
 __
 
• Located at Bhoramdev Dham in Kabirdham district, Chhattisgarh.
 
• Bhoramdev Temple is known as the “Khajuraho of Chhattisgarh”.
 
• Will provide modern facilities for pilgrims and tourists.
 
 
 
• Development Impact__
 
 
• Expected to enhance tourism.
